function.name: find_object
function.description: Find remembered objects whose label or alias matches the name. Returns matches with label and minutes since last seen, or not_found.

name.description: What the user is looking for, e.g. 'keys'

function.name: describe_location
function.description: Where an object is: room, landmark, relation, shelf level, height band and minutes since seen. Only use what this returns.

function.name: localize
function.description: The user's current position and facing in the home frame, and the tracking state.

function.name: plan_route
function.description: Steps from the user to the object as clock-face turns and metres, or no_safe_path.
